optimizedDescription.value: Single artifact-validation chokepoint enforces schema, DAG, delta, metadata, cross-artifact, approval-drift, and completion invariants.

optimizedContext.value:
# ValidateArtifacts
## Rules
- Constructor: `ChangeRepository`, `ListWorkspaces`, `SchemaProvider`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `ActorResolver`, `ContentHasher`, `ExtractorTransformRegistry`, `SpecWorkspaceRoute[]`; `SchemaProvider` lazy/cached; workspace lookup through `ListWorkspaces`; DAG via module `evaluateLifecycleVerdict` with empty `checksByTarget`.
- `specPath` required for `scope: spec`; optional/ignored for `scope: change`. Change artifact routes by `artifactId`, never `change.specIds`. Load change, then require `schema.name() === change.schemaName`, else throw `SchemaMismatchError` before validation.
- Full validation: every non-optional non-`missing`; optional `skipped` resolved. Skip full-set check when `artifactId`. Multi-artifact traversal follows `schema.artifactDag().topologicalOrder()`; outer batch type order topological, spec files `change.specIds` order.
- Before each artifact, require `requires` effective status `complete` or `skipped`; report dependency ID/status; review states explicit; `pending-parent-artifact-review` includes upstream blocker. Evaluate DAG once, patch in-memory verdict after completion; never persist/re-evaluate between files.
- Canonical `complete`/`skipped` bypass structural read/validation/delta preview/`markComplete`; selected nonterminal/review files validate. Consent-hash scan still covers complete files with active approval/signoff.
- Establish expected path/presence before `validatedHash`; required absence canonical `missing`, failure names expected path, never complete. Existing concrete delta-capable base → `deltas/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>.delta.yaml`; absent concrete base/new artifact → `specs/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>`; change artifact → root basename. No fallback. Delta eligibility per concrete artifact base; reject mixed new direct/delta without each concrete base.
- Non-no-op delta: parse normalized delta AST; run `deltaValidations[]`; load/parse base; `parser.apply`; map `DeltaApplicationError` failure; serialize merged AST; run `validations[]`; never mutate `SpecRepository`. All-`no-op` delta skips validation/application/base load; raw hash then completion.
- Rule algorithm for `deltaValidations` and `validations`: select core:selector-model fields or JSONPath `path`; zero matches failure if `required`, warning otherwise; enforce total/unique `count`; per node `contentMatches` against `parser.renderSubtree(node)`; recurse `children`; collect all failures/warnings.
- After local success, run applicable `crossArtifactValidations`: same scope/spec, and filtered invocation references `artifactId`. Participant ready: expected file + local pass + parsed materialized output; rehydrate needed prior `complete` participants identically; unavailable participants defer warning. Resolve selectors/keySelector/key extraction/capture/strip; `all-equal`, directional `subset [A,B]` = A ⊆ B, `superset [A,B]` = B ⊆ A; ignore or strict relative ordering; mismatch fails participant set.
- Extract metadata via `extractMetadata(schema.metadataExtraction(), astsByArtifact, renderers, transforms, transformContext, artifactType.id)`; validate `strictSpecMetadataSchema`; transform/metadata errors fail. Successful spec `dependsOn` updates `change.specDependsOn`; canonical `spec-lock.json` difference does not fail.
- With active approval/signoff, hash all non-`missing`/non-`skipped` candidates after `preHashCleanup`; compare `artifactHashes` `type:key`; group mismatches, preserve absent as `missing`, mark present `drifted-pending-review`, recompute parents, then one `Change.invalidate(`artifact-drift`, actor, focusedPayload)`. Never compare baseline `validatedHash` here; repository load owns baseline drift. Policy `none` reports mismatch without reopen.
- Success: ordered `preHashCleanup`, SHA-256 cleaned raw content, `change.getArtifact(type).markComplete(key, cleanedHash)`. Return, do not throw, validation failures: `passed`, `failures`, `warnings`, `files` with artifact/key/expected filename/outcome. Persist completion, invalidation, hashes, `setSpecDependsOn` through fresh `ChangeRepository.mutate(name, fn)`; preserve partial progress.
## Constraints
- Only `ValidateArtifacts` calls `Artifact.markComplete(hash)`.
- Never write merged specs to `SpecRepository`; only `ArchiveChange`.
- One focused `artifact-drift` invalidation maximum per `execute`.
- `preHashCleanup` changes hash only, never disk.
- Missing `deltaValidations[]`/`validations[]` skips validation.
